manta-ray-pet.title: Manta Ray Encounter
manta-ray-pet.description: A close encounter with a manta ray moving through the clear lagoon water of Moorea.
manta-ray-pet.alt: Manta ray swimming through clear blue water in Moorea.

eagle-rays-3.title: Eagle Rays
eagle-rays-3.description: Eagle rays gliding through open blue water above the reef.
eagle-rays-3.alt: Eagle rays gliding through blue water above a reef in Moorea.

close-up-sharks.title: Sharks on the Reef
close-up-sharks.description: Close views of sharks cruising above the reef and sandy bottom.
close-up-sharks.alt: Sharks swimming above reef and sand in clear tropical water.

moorea-coral-garden-with-turtle.title: Coral Garden & Sea Turtle
moorea-coral-garden-with-turtle.description: A sea turtle moving through a broad coral garden in Moorea.
moorea-coral-garden-with-turtle.alt: Sea turtle swimming through a coral garden in Moorea.

manta-w-angelfish.title: Manta Ray & Angelfish
manta-w-angelfish.description: A manta ray passing through the reef with angelfish and other tropical fish in the scene.
manta-w-angelfish.alt: Manta ray and tropical reef fish in clear blue water.

moorea-fish-schools.title: Schools of Reef Fish
moorea-fish-schools.description: Large schools of reef fish shifting across coral habitat in clear lagoon water.
moorea-fish-schools.alt: Schools of reef fish moving above coral habitat in Moorea.

aquarium-school-w-needles.title: Needlefish School
aquarium-school-w-needles.description: A school of needlefish moving over coral in the shallow, clear water of Moorea.
aquarium-school-w-needles.alt: School of needlefish above coral in shallow blue water.

moorea-sting-ray.title: Stingray
moorea-sting-ray.description: A stingray crossing shallow reef habitat and sandy bottom.
moorea-sting-ray.alt: Stingray moving across shallow reef habitat in Moorea.

coral-garden-aquariam.title: Coral Garden
coral-garden-aquariam.description: A compact reef scene with layered coral structure and scattered tropical fish.
coral-garden-aquariam.alt: Layered coral formations and tropical reef fish in Moorea.

coral-garden-2.title: Coral Garden I
coral-garden-2.description: A long drift across dense coral formations and the small reef fish moving between them.
coral-garden-2.alt: Dense coral garden with small reef fish moving between formations.

coral-garden2-part.title: Coral Garden II
coral-garden2-part.description: An extended pass through a varied coral garden, with branching colonies, reef fish, and open sand.
coral-garden2-part.alt: Branching coral colonies, reef fish, and open sand in Moorea.
